label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_01
text: I see you took care of the guards. Nice work.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_02
text: Now, holed up in that base is Team Star’s Dark\ncrew—the Segin Squad.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_03
text: Their boss, Giacomo, pretty much runs the whole\nof Team Star, and he also produced that wild\r\nsoundtrack of theirs himself.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_04
text: He’s a sharp guy. Even our declaration of war\nwon’t have ruffled him in the slightest.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_05
text: His plan is probably to wear you down with a\nwave of grunts, then finish you off himself.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_06
text: No use trying to outthink strategic types like him.\nBring him down with a head-on attack![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_07
text: Just keep on defeating as many Pokémon as you\ncan until the big man himself shows up.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_aku_020_cassiopeia_09
text: Ring the bell on the gates once you’re ready to\nkick off this phase of the operation.\c\nTime to wipe the Segin Squad off the map![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
